integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the model, threshold, endemic-equilibrium, Lyapunov-function, and derivative-inequality passages. The witness uses exact rational arithmetic and a bundled verifier. Related SIR/SIRS stability methods and semantic database records were compared at statement and implication level. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The finding invalidates the source's displayed Lyapunov inequality and proof, but does not assert that the endemic equilibrium is unstable or that global convergence itself is false.
The exact witness concerns the autonomous constant-climate system used in the source's stability theorem, not the time-dependent climate simulations.
No corrected global-stability theorem is claimed.
